name: Home Bistro

items.summary: Palatine の飲食店で DBA 名称変更(Kolatek Baking Company → Home Bistro)に伴う恒久的食品営業許可の申請。工事や設備投資は伴わない。
items.verbatim: We are filing for a new business permit reflecting a name change to our new DBA "Home Bistro". Kolatek Baking Company is still going to be a part of this business but taking a back seat to Home Bistro. Nothing else is changing, the establishment will be exactly the same as it was. / Permanent Food
